//: Type-checks the test suite. It is a SEPARATE config on purpose: tsconfig.json drives the deploy build (rootDir 'src' -> outDir 'lib'), so folding 'test' into its `include` would either be refused by rootDir or start emitting test files into the shipped bundle. This config emits nothing (`noEmit`) and only reads. The src/ modules the tests import are pulled in transitively, so they are not listed in `include` again. `npm run typecheck` runs it alongside the build config and the scripts config.
//exclude: `exclude` is NOT inherited usefully here: the base config excludes 'test', and exclude is applied AFTER include, so without this override the base's entry would filter out every file this config exists to check — silently, with a green 0-error run.
